name: B10-0212/2025 (ESN) – Targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – defending religious freedom and security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the killing of Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo by Islamist armed groups. It calls on the Congolese authorities to investigate the murders, bring the killers to justice and protect Christian communities. It asks the European Union to act diplomatically, urges African bodies to lead on security, and wants the EU to suspend its raw materials deal with Rwanda. The text is a statement of position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a set of demands and condemnations.
- **Who it affects:** The EU, the DRC, Rwanda, African Union bodies and Christian communities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to those bodies; they decide whether to act.
